description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TASK_HISTORY() - the table function a scheduler polls. Covers the no-argument call's column layout (name, state, scheduled_time), the TASK_NAME => filter answering empty for a task that has never run, the RESULT_LIMIT => cap, and the name resolution rule: TASK_HISTORY lives ONLY under INFORMATION_SCHEMA, so the bare name is an invalid identifier while the database-qualified form works. Converted 1:1 from features/TaskHistoryFunctionTest (now retired); its setupTest fixture (test_wh warehouse + my_task) is inlined per test and the account-level warehouse is dropped again.
